This is a simple notebook to launch the VSCode server on the 
cluster. It will build a singularity container with all the 
dependencies and launch the server.

## 9. Build final SIF with submitit

```{python}
#| eval: false
import submitit

n_cpus = 12

executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(folder=str(SUBMITIT_DIR / "%j"))

executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=360,
    slurm_partition="hsph",
    mem_gb=32.0,
    cpus_per_task=n_cpus,
    slurm_job_name=f"build-{PROJECT_NAME}-container",
)
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
def build_container(singularity_def=SINGULARITY_DEF, singularity_sif=SINGULARITY_SIF):
    from spython.main import Client
    from pathlib import Path
    import os

    job_id = os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID", "local")
    user = os.environ["USER"]

    tmp_root = Path(f"/tmp/{user}-rse-workbench-{job_id}")
    singularity_tmp = tmp_root / "singularity-tmp"
    singularity_cache = tmp_root / "singularity-cache"

    singularity_tmp.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    singularity_cache.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    os.environ["SINGULARITY_TMPDIR"] = str(singularity_tmp)
    os.environ["SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR"] = str(singularity_cache)
    os.environ["APPTAINER_TMPDIR"] = str(singularity_tmp)
    os.environ["APPTAINER_CACHEDIR"] = str(singularity_cache)

    return Client.build(
        image=str(singularity_sif),
        recipe=str(singularity_def),
        options=[
            "--fakeroot", "--force"
            ],
        sudo=False,
        return_result=True,
    )
```

Patch placeholders before submission.

```{python}
#| eval: false

job = executor.submit(build_container)
job.job_id
```

```{python}
#| eval: false
show_submitit_job(job)
```

Here are some preparatory steps for building:

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os


def prepare_singularity_runtime(project_dir: Path):
    job_id = os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID", "local")
    user = os.environ["USER"]

    tmp_root = Path(f"/tmp/{user}-rse-workbench-{job_id}")

    singularity_tmp = tmp_root / "singularity-tmp"
    singularity_cache = tmp_root / "singularity-cache"
    container_home = project_dir / ".container-home"

    for p in (singularity_tmp, singularity_cache, container_home):
        p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    os.environ.update({
        "SINGULARITY_TMPDIR": str(singularity_tmp),
        "SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR": str(singularity_cache),
        "APPTAINER_TMPDIR": str(singularity_tmp),
        "APPTAINER_CACHEDIR": str(singularity_cache),

        # forwarded into the container
        "SINGULARITYENV_HOME": "/home/rse",
        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_CACHE_HOME": "/home/rse/.cache",
        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_CONFIG_HOME": "/home/rse/.config",
        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_DATA_HOME": "/home/rse/.local/share",

        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS": "",
        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS_USER": "",
        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS_SITE": "",

        "SINGULARITYENV_SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG": "true",
    })

    return [
        "--cleanenv",
        "--containall",
        "--home", f"{container_home}:/home/rse",
        "--bind", f"{project_dir}:/work",
    ]
```

```{python}
def install_in_container():
    from spython.main import Client
    from pathlib import Path
    import os

    project_dir = Path(PROJECT_DIR)
    singularity_sif = Path(SINGULARITY_SIF)

    job_id = os.environ.get("SLURM_JOB_ID", "local")
    user = os.environ["USER"]

    tmp_root = Path(f"/tmp/{user}-rse-workbench-{job_id}")
    singularity_tmp = tmp_root / "singularity-tmp"
    singularity_cache = tmp_root / "singularity-cache"
    container_home = project_dir / ".container-home"

    for path in [singularity_tmp, singularity_cache, container_home]:
        path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Host-side Singularity/Apptainer runtime locations.
    os.environ.update({
        "SINGULARITY_TMPDIR": str(singularity_tmp),
        "SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR": str(singularity_cache),
        "APPTAINER_TMPDIR": str(singularity_tmp),
        "APPTAINER_CACHEDIR": str(singularity_cache),

        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_CACHE_HOME": "/home/rse/.cache",
        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_CONFIG_HOME": "/home/rse/.config",
        "SINGULARITYENV_XDG_DATA_HOME": "/home/rse/.local/share",

        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS": "",
        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS_USER": "",
        "SINGULARITYENV_R_LIBS_SITE": "",
        "SINGULARITYENV_SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG": "true",
    })

    options = [
        "--cleanenv",
        "--containall",
        "--home", f"{container_home}:/home/rse",
        "--bind", f"{project_dir}:/work",
    ]
    runtime_command = """
set -euo pipefail

export TMPDIR=/work/.spack/tmp
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"

. /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh
cd /work

spack env activate -d .
spack concretize
spack install --deprecated --fail-fast -j12 --no-checksum

rv sync || true
"""

    result = Client.execute(
        image=str(singularity_sif),
        command=[
            "bash",
            "--noprofile",
            "--norc",
            "-lc",
            runtime_command,
        ],
        options=options,
        sudo=False,
        return_result=True,
    )

    return result
```

```{python}
#| eval: false

job = executor.submit(install_in_container)
job.job_id
```


## 10. Runtime command

The SIF is read-only. Do not launch it with `--writable`.

At runtime, bind the project into `/work`, activate the project Spack environment, install/update project dependencies as needed, and then launch `code-server` or run the pipeline.

```{python}
runtime_command = [
    "export SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=true",
    ". /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh",
    "cd /work",
    "spack env activate -d .",
    "spack concretize",
    "spack install --deprecated --fail-fast -j12 --no-checksum",
    "rv sync || true",
    f"code tunnel --accept-server-license-terms --name {PROJECT_NAME}-vscode /work",
]
runtime_command
```

A launch script can be generated later from this list, or executed through a Python/Slurm interface. The important runtime contract is:

```bash
singularity exec \
  --no-home \
  --bind "$PROJECT_DIR:/work" \
  "$SINGULARITY_SIF" \
  bash --noprofile --norc -lc '<runtime command>'
```

Let's see if we can write the runtime command to our
project-local `launch.sh` script. We'll use `simple_slurm`
for this. First, set the job params:

```{python}
from simple_slurm import Slurm

mem = {
    "small": "4G",
    "medium": "8G",
    "big": "32G",
}

n_hours = 6
n_cpus = 12

slurm = Slurm(
    job_name=f"launch-{PROJECT_NAME}-container", 
    cpus_per_task=n_cpus, 
    mem=mem["big"], 
    time=f"0{n_hours}:00:00", 
    partition="hsph",
    mail_user="aaaapr3lk7gfdswioulcmvi3te@harvard.org.slack.com",
    output=str(PROJECT_DIR / "slurm" / "launch" / "logs" / "launch-%j.out"),
    error=str(PROJECT_DIR / "slurm" / "launch" / "logs" / "launch-%j.err")
)

print(slurm)

slurm.add_cmd("set -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail")
```

Next, set the project level variabless

```{python}
slurm.add_cmd(f"PROJECT_DIR=${{PROJECT_DIR}}")
slurm.add_cmd(f"SIF=${{PROJECT_DIR}}/.devcontainer/Singularity.sif")
slurm.add_cmd(f"CONTAINER_HOME=${{PROJECT_DIR}}/.container-home")

slurm.add_cmd(f"mkdir -p ${{PROJECT_DIR}}/slurm/launch/logs")
slurm.add_cmd(f"mkdir -p ${{CONTAINER_HOME}}")

slurm.add_cmd(f"cd ${{PROJECT_DIR}}")
```

Next, add some logging to the launch script:

```{python}
slurm.add_cmd("""
cho "================ Slurm tunnel test ================"
echo "Date:         $(date)"
echo "Host:         $(hostname)"
echo "User:         $(whoami)"
echo "Job ID:       ${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
echo "Project:      ${PROJECT_DIR}"
echo "SIF:          ${SIF}"
echo "Home:         ${CONTAINER_HOME}"
echo "Tunnel:       ${TUNNEL_NAME}"
echo "==================================================="

module purge
""")
```

Finally, the runtime command:

```{python}
slurm.add_cmd(r"singularity exec --no-home --bind ${PROJECT_DIR}:/work ${SIF} bash --noprofile --norc -lc '" + " && ".join(runtime_command) + "'")
```

And we write this to file:

```{python}
LAUNCH_SCRIPT = PROJECT_DIR / "slurm" / "launch" / "launch_container.sh"
with open(LAUNCH_SCRIPT, "w") as f:
    script = slurm.script(shell="bash")
    f.write(script)
    
LAUNCH_SCRIPT.chmod(0o755)
```

```{python}
Path(LAUNCH_SCRIPT).exists()
```
